messages:
Maya: Pickle found the shoebox under my desk and has declared it the official company hammock. :sun_with_face: Photo: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T1234-F5678/pickle_shoebox.jpg
Jon: That is a regal loaf. He looks like he handles payroll and snacks. :sunglasses:
Priya: his judgmental loaf face is immaculate. vote: calendar? :calendar: :heart:
Arun: I nominate Pickle for CTO of naps. He meets all KPI (Knead Per Indentation). :thumbsup:
Maya: He only accepts meetings if we bring snacks and a catnip agenda. Also he rotates positions every 20 min to maintain box dominance.
Jon: I'm setting a reminder to attend his 10am 'stretch and stare' standup tomorrow. will bring tuna.
Priya: low-effort merch idea: "Pickle's Box Co." t-shirts?
Arun: +1 for merch. Also can someone photoshop him into a tiny suit? :laughing:
Maya: Adding to my weekend to-do: make tiny tie. updates to follow. :camera_with_flash:
Jon reacted with :heart:
